Implemented the fix.

- `lib/adapters/http.js`: when `maxBodyLength <= -1`, explicitly set `options.maxBodyLength = Infinity` so `follow-redirects` no longer applies its undocumented 10MB default. This makes the default unlimited consistently, regardless of `maxRedirects`.
- `README.md`: documented the default as unlimited (`-1`).

Validation:
- Target tests pass: `should support max body length`, `should properly support default max body length (follow-redirects as well)`.
- ESLint passes for the changed adapter.
- Full HTTP adapter suite shows only pre-existing/environment-related failures (HTTPS network timeout, and a max-content-length test that passes when run alone).
